end.summary:
Aditya identified cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toy and everyday examples.
They counted two flat faces and identified circular ends for a cylinder.
They repeatedly treated a long box as a cube and changed a cone’s name when turned.
Teach-back was not passed; 4 of 8 attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming 3-D shapes in toys and objects, including checking cylinder faces and circular ends. Aditya used examples such as a candle, pencil, cricket ball and space-station tower. They mixed up a long cuboid with a cube and thought an upside-down cone changes its name; these mix-ups were still present at the last seen response. At home, ask them to sort boxes by checking whether all faces are equal squares, and turn a cone around while keeping its name the same.
